name: com.outova/sage100-mcp
title: Sage 100 (US), read-only
description: Read-only US Sage 100 data: AR, AP, orders, inventory and GL by company. ProvideX on Windows.

environmentVariables.name: SAGE100_MCP_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to config.yaml; by default %ProgramData%\sage100-mcp\config.yaml on Windows. `sage100-mcp init` writes it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: A bearer token from `sage100-mcp token create`, or an OAuth access token

environmentVariables.name: SAGE100_MCP_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to config.yaml, whose http section sets the address, TLS and authentication

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.notes: Sage 100 Standard and Advanced (ProvideX ODBC) need the Sage driver, a Windows DLL, so that backend runs on Windows only. Premium (SQL Server) runs anywhere with Microsoft ODBC Driver 18. Remote clients reach `serve` over Streamable HTTP with TLS and a token. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Sage.
